cases.distance: shortest weighted path along pristine induced-region edges
cases.direction: negative center area-weighted incident-face normal, fixed sign

method.energy_R: F union all original-edge neighbors of F
method.columns_C: R union all original-edge neighbors of R
method.stiffness: Kii += half cotangent, Kij -= half cotangent, assembled completely over all abnormal triangles incident to R
method.mass: diagonal lumped incident area/3 at R
method.constraints: all C outside F fixed at observed abnormal coordinates; entire output outside F bitwise preserved
method.failure: zero incident area/mass, nonfinite values or rank below338 recorded as method failure
method.normal_control: same function and interface without case-specific branch
method.operator_source: all weights/masses recomputed from each abnormal input

statistics: normalized by pristine mean induced-edge length
evaluation.contact: reuse002 endpoint surface evaluator, uniform410 region and898incident faces; separately reference-to-damage and damage-to-repair changes
evaluation.split: one asset group, development-only, no train/test claim

visualization.camera: one fixed45deg oblique orthographic normal-based frame
visualization.framing: one common union extent for comparison, fixed center detail extent
